description: This file contains extension methods for the ShellSettings class, providing utility functions to check tenant states, URL configurations, and modify tenant settings within the OrchardCore framework.

classes.name: ShellSettingsExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for ShellSettings to determine tenant states, URL configurations, and modify settings.

methods.name: IsDefaultShell
methods.description: Checks if the tenant is the default shell based on its name.

methods.name: IsUninitialized
methods.description: Checks if the tenant is uninitialized.

methods.name: IsInitializing
methods.description: Checks if the tenant is in the initializing state.

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the tenant is currently running.

methods.name: IsDisabled
methods.description: Checks if the tenant is disabled.

methods.name: IsInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the tenant is either running or disabled.

methods.name: IsRemovable
methods.description: Checks if the tenant can be removed (uninitialized or disabled).

methods.name: HasConfiguration
methods.description: Determines if the tenant configuration has not been disposed.

methods.name: HasUrlPrefix
methods.description: Checks if the tenant has the specified URL prefix.

methods.name: HasUrlHost
methods.description: Checks if the tenant has one of the specified URL hosts.

methods.name: AsDefaultShell
methods.description: Sets the tenant as the default shell.

methods.name: AsDisposable
methods.description: Marks the tenant settings to be disposable.
